target_customer: Colombian companies, fintechs, wallets and banks that need to collect and disburse money in real time
problem: Colombian account to account payments ran through PSE and ACH cycles with delays and fixed fees. Companies could not collect or disburse instantly across all banks.
business_model: B2B payments API with per transaction fees
product_category: Real-time account to account payments infrastructure

founders.name: Juan Luis Perez E
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder and CEO with no other background.

founders.name: Daniel Gomez
founders.background_notes: YC bio: product manager and strategist who built projects in fintech, mobility and healthcare.

founders.name: Toni Riera
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page under former founders.

technical_complexity.rationale: Single API over many Colombian banks and wallets needs bank integrations and compliance, which is more integration work than novel engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Bank connections and licensing partnerships are slow to replicate, but the central bank later launched a public rail.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Colombia's central bank launched the Bre-B interoperable instant payment system in October 2025, which covers the same wedge as a public rail.

market_need_then: The YC description says PSE and ACH rails were slow and charged fixed rates, and companies wanted 24/7 immediate disbursement.

branding.domain_note: Uses miliopay.com, not milio.com, as its site.

identity.logo: Wordmark Milio, styled Miliopay on the site
identity.visual_style: Corporate fintech with YC and PCI badges
identity.voice_and_tone: Infrastructure claims in Spanish such as moving money in seconds

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found, and the pay suffix domain suggests the plain name was unavailable.

outcome_analysis: Milio is still active with about 16 people per YC. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding figures conflict across aggregators, so its progress cannot be judged. The Bre-B central bank rail launched in 2025 is a risk to the original wedge and the company's site now describes cross border and bank core connections.
notes: Funding unverified: Seedtable and VCBacked say 2M USD pre-seed with Rebel Fund and Houghton Street; PitchBook and CB Insights say 500K. No primary source, so no round recorded. One aggregator names Erwin Alzate as co-founder, not on the YC page, so omitted. Competitor search returned no dated sources near 2023, so the list is empty.
